spans.text: At one time the Buddha was staying near Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s monastery.

entries.task_id: but|it’s|possible that the mendicants do accuse that mendicant in the middle of the saṅgha …
entries.description: But it’s possible that the mendicants do accuse that mendicant in the middle of the Saṅgha …
entries.subject: But
entries.object: possible that the mendicants do accuse that mendicant in the middle of the Saṅgha …

spans.text: But it’s possible that the mendicants do accuse that mendicant in the middle of the Saṅgha …
But it’s possible that someone who is not a peer accuses that mendicant …
But it’s possible that the mendicants will enter the village for the meal putting some other mendicant at the very front …
But it’s possible that some other mendicant gets the best seat, the best drink, and the best almsfood in the refectory …
But it’s possible that some other mendicant gives the verses of appreciation after eating in the refectory …

entries.description: hope I’m accused by a peer
entries.subject: hope I’m

spans.text: ‘If I commit an offense, I hope I’m accused by a peer, not by someone who is not a peer.’
